evidence_slices.fact: The product provides authoritative relationships between UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs and is updated every six weeks.
TopographicArea is a TOID-identified OS MasterMap Topography Layer polygon limited to a building outline or road surface area; BLPU uses UPRN from AddressBase Premium.

The UPRN-to-TopographicArea TOID relationship is extracted for all live, provisional and historic BLPU records and is determined by point-in-polygon intersection between the Address seed location and the TopographicArea polygon.
The BLPU UPRN to TopographicArea TOID link can be used to calculate the area of the building footprint related to an address.
The relationship is supplied as CSV in the OS Open Linked Identifiers package with an accompanying version JSON and OGL licence file.

guardrails: No individual UPRN or TOID value was invented.
No building polygon geometry was fabricated.
No canonical parcel ID or local relationship match was inferred.
No Internet Access coverage value was inferred.
